transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... mostly it's just my sleep. It's gotten pretty messed up lately. I just... I'll stay up half the night with my mind running, or I wake up way too early. I just never really feel rested. So... yeah.
When you sleep only a few hours, do you still feel full of energy the next day?
Um... yeah, I guess. Sometimes. There were a few nights where I only slept maybe three or four hours. But I still got up feeling... I don't know, charged, I guess. Like I didn't even need coffee.
During those times when you felt charged on very little sleep, did you also feel unusually happy or high?

I mean... maybe a little. Earlier this month, I felt... I don't know, kind of lit up. Like I was unstoppable, I guess. But... I also got easily annoyed. I'd snap at my mom, or my supervisor at work... just over little questions that normally wouldn't even bother me. So... yeah.
During those charged periods, did you find yourself starting lots of new projects or activities?

Um... yeah, I guess. I had this... burst of energy for a while. I would just come home from work and start cleaning. And... I don't know, making lists for renovations, checking interest rates. I even started looking into some side-job ideas. It was just... I just kept doing things after work. Like I couldn't shut it off. But... yeah.
During that charged period, did you do anything unusually risky or out of character, like spending more money than usual?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I didn't buy anything crazy or... do anything like that. I'm usually pretty careful with my money, so... no. I don't think so.
During that charged period, did it cause serious problems in your life, like trouble at work or needing emergency care?
No... nothing like that. I mean, I still went in to work and did my job. I didn't need a hospital or anything. It wasn't... it didn't cause any big problems.
About how many days in a row did that charged period last?
Um... I'm not really sure. I didn't exactly count. Maybe... a few days? Or a week? I just... I don't really remember exactly how long it was.
Did that charged period last at least four days in a row?
I... I guess so. Like I said, it might have been a few days, but I didn't really count if it was exactly four. I just... I don't know for sure.
During that charged period, were you more talkative than usual?

I suppose so. Um... my sister said I was. She told me I was talking so fast about things like equity and taxes, and... paint colors, I think. She complained that she couldn't really get a word in. I don't know, I just... I could feel myself kind of pushing to keep going.
During that charged period, did your thoughts feel like they were racing?

Yeah, I guess. Um... they were just jumping around a lot. Like, I'd be thinking about mortgage payments, and then suddenly it's... CPA study schedules, or... kitchen cabinets. It was all just moving so fast. I couldn't really get them to slow down enough to just... relax.
During that charged period, did you feel unusually confident or powerful, like you could do things other people couldn’t?

I mean... maybe a little? I just... I don't know, I honestly started thinking I could pay my condo down really fast. And... pass all the CPA exams. I even thought I could run a little bookkeeping business on the side. It just felt like... I don't know, like failure just wasn't an option. But... yeah.
Have you had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Lately, I just... I wake up with this really heavy, empty feeling. I don't really know how to explain it. It's just... even sitting in my own condo, the one I worked so hard for... it just makes me want to cry. So... yeah.
During that depressed period, did you lose interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I don't really do much right now. I stopped going to my salsa class. And... my paints are just sitting out on the table. I look at them and... I don't know. I just feel nothing. It's like they belong to somebody else.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of killing yourself?
Um... no. I mean... I just feel really down, but... no, I haven't thought about anything like that.
During that charged period, were you functioning noticeably differently from your usual self?

Um... maybe a little. I mean... I'm still getting to work. But... I guess I've made some reconciliation mistakes lately. Enough that my supervisor pulled me aside to say something about it. And... yeah, like I said before, I've been avoiding my salsa class... and my friends, mostly. I just... I don't really feel like myself.
During that charged period, were you more active than usual or driven to get a lot more done?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean... for a little bit, I just had this... burst of energy. Like, after work, I'd just keep going. I was... cleaning a lot. And I started making all these lists for renovating my apartment... looking up interest rates, trying to set up ideas for side jobs. It just felt like... I couldn't shut it off.
Thinking about that charged period, did it last four full days in a row?
Um... I'm not really sure. I wasn't... exactly counting the days. It just felt like a few days, maybe.
Thinking back to that energized period, did it definitely continue for four days in a row?
I mean... I really don't know for sure. Like I said, I wasn't keeping track of the exact days. It just... it felt like a few days. I can't really give you a definite number.
During that energized period, were you much more active than usual or driven to get a lot more done?

Yeah, um... kind of like I was saying before. I just... I started emailing people to see about doing their books. And I was mapping out those condo projects. I even started calling my relatives just to... talk through all the plans. It was just... way more than I usually do.
During that energized period, were you much more active than usual or driven to get a lot more done?

Um... didn't I just answer that? But... yeah. Like I just mentioned, I was sending out all those emails to see about doing people's books... and mapping out those condo projects. And calling my relatives to talk about the plans. I was just doing way more than I normally would.
